title: From Transient Prompts to Persistent Control: Scientific Poster Generation via Recursive Semantic-Geometric Contracts
abstract: arXiv:2609.17326v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Scientific poster generation distills a multimodal paper into a single-page visual artifact, forcing strict trade-offs between informational coverage and readability under a fixed spatial budget. Existing methods pass plans as transient prompts and validate individual stages in isolation. This strategy causes requirements to drift across content and layout modules, and previous checks to be silently invalidated. We introduce PosterVisor, a control framework that shifts poster generation from transient prompts to persistent control. An Orchestrator grounds rubrics in the paper and visual assets, compiling them into a Semantic-Geometric Contract (SGC) that binds claims and sources to required visuals, budgets, and spatial commitments. Only fully instantiated records become executable assertions; other usable requirements remain soft guidance. Recursive Contract Enforcement (RCE) dynamically triggers checks across stages as evidence emerges

translated_title: 从瞬态提示到持久控制：基于递归语义-几何契约的科学海报生成
translated_abstract: 科学海报生成需要将一篇多模态论文提炼为单页视觉作品，在固定的空间预算下，必须在信息覆盖度与可读性之间进行严格权衡。现有方法将规划作为瞬态提示传递，并对各个阶段进行孤立验证。这种策略导致需求在内容与布局模块之间发生漂移，且先前的检查被静默地失效。我们提出PosterVisor，一个将海报生成从瞬态提示转变为持久控制的控制框架。编排器将评分标准锚定于论文和视觉资产，将其编译为语义-几何契约（SGC），将论断与来源绑定到所需的视觉元素、预算和空间承诺。只有完全实例化的记录才能成为可执行断言，其他可用的需求则保持为软性指导。递归契约执行（RCE）随着证据的出现，在各阶段之间动态触发检查。
tldr: 该论文提出PosterVisor控制框架，通过语义-几何契约（SGC）将论断、视觉需求与空间预算绑定，并借助递归契约执行（RCE）在各阶段动态触发检查，从而将科学海报生成从瞬态提示转变为持久控制，解决了现有方法中需求漂移与检查静默失效的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces PosterVisor, a control framework that shifts scientific poster generation from transient prompts to persistent control by binding claims, visual requirements, and spatial budgets through Semantic-Geometric Contracts (SGC) and dynamically triggering cross-stage checks via Recursive Contract Enforcement (RCE), thereby solving requirement drift and silent check invalidation in existing methods.
